title: buddleja albiflora var. hemsleyana
intro: Buddleja albiflora var. hemsleyana, commonly known as White Butterfly Bush, is a flowering plant species native to China. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, sore throat, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of White Butterfly Bush include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infection, and alleviate symptoms of illness. The bioactive constituents of White Butterfly Bush include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
